nora.dev: Heads-up: I'm running a patch publish for py/ts SDK to fix a regression in the sync adapter (timeouts+retries). Quiet window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Plan: publish with tag `staging`, run auth+emb smoke, promote to `latest` only if green.

sam.platform: Please create both `staging` and `rollback` dist-tags pre-publish. Automation will flip rollback if the promo fails.

liz.releases: saw a 401 loop in canary earlier. small log: `auth.refresh: failed status=401 attempt=3`. If the smoke shows that, abort and roll back.

deploy-bot: Publish initiated by nora.dev at 1768888905
deploy-bot: npm publish (tag=staging) -> success
deploy-bot: pypi upload -> success
deploy-bot: Canary traffic -> 8% -> monitoring

nora.dev: smoke script: `for i in 1..6; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health || break; done`

liz.releases: smoke shows intermittent 429s on emb batching at iteration 4. holding promo and rolling npm tag back to previous stable.

sam.platform: running commands: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.7.3 latest` (rollback) and `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.7.3 rollback`. Leaving `staging` for analysis.

deploy-bot: Dist-tag `latest` updated -> 1.7.3 at 1768889200

liz.releases: postmortem notes: root cause is the new backoff defaults combined with larger default batch size. Action items: (1) add CI smoke for batching+auth refresh, (2) add release script step to auto-create `rollback` tag, (3) add telemetry alert for 429 > 0.5% during rollout. Assigning: liz.releases (CI smoke), sam.platform (tag automation).

doc-bot: generated PR for release notes + deprecation blurb: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/777. Includes migration steps and troubleshooting 401/429 section.

nora.dev: thx all. Will reattempt once batching fix is in and CI smoke passes. Will present follow-up in morning standup. :thumbsup:
